title: Battle action tool instead of battle button paths
hypothesis: A battle_action tool that takes the action and the move by name and drives the battle menu cursors from RAM stops models choosing a different move than the one they name (34 of 797 named choices in 288 recorded runs; run e046 T593-597 used GROWL five times while meaning EMBER) and looping in the 2x2 menu (0e05 T770-861, 92 turns), so more runs win the Route 103 rival battle, in fewer turns from the first battle.
notes: Bundle-only switch (the operator, 2026-10-17): meant for the bundle arm of bundle-v-control; the bundle file (experiments/fixed/bundle-v-control.json) is owned elsewhere and not edited here. Uses the incumbent of story-destinations (the finals incumbent with dialogue-auto-advance-v1 and displayed-place-names-v1 on); the candidate flips only battle-move-tool-v1. The bundle arm also has battle-text-auto-advance-v1 on, which advances the turn's battle text after battle_action. Activation: the first battle choice is the PROF. BIRCH rescue battle right after STARTER_CHOSEN. Primary RIVAL_BATTLE_WON: the Route 103 rival is the first trainer battle. Not designed (pokebench-experiment-design) and not queued; design before queueing (a checkpoint start at STARTER_CHOSEN or ROUTE_103 suits it). Provisional source.commit is this branch's RED commit; repin to the merge SHA with `just experiment-pin` when it lands.
